sections.description:
Unlock True Web Inclusivity with A11y Accessibility Enhancer – The Ultimate Free WordPress Accessibility Plugin

In a world where digital accessibility is essential, A11y Accessibility Enhancer stands out as the best free WordPress plugin for WCAG 2.2 and ADA compliance. This powerful tool equips your site with a customizable widget that lets users tailor their experience: resize fonts, adjust contrast, enable text-to-speech, reduce motion, and more. Designed for everyone – from visually impaired users to those with dyslexia or color blindness – it ensures your content is accessible, engaging, and legally compliant.

Why settle for basic tools? A11y is lightweight (under 50KB), multilingual (36 languages), and packed with auto-fixes that resolve common issues instantly. Boost SEO, reduce bounce rates, and avoid lawsuits – all while making your site the most inclusive on the web. Perfect for blogs, e-shops, or agencies using Elementor, Divi, or WooCommerce.

Core Features

  • Smart Buttons for Instant Adjustments: Tap to cycle font sizes, contrast levels, text spacing, link underlines, and motion reduction. Hold for advanced modes like dyslexia fonts or color-blind filters – with visual cues for intuitive use.
  • Text-to-Speech (TTS): Select text for browser-based reading in any language, enhancing screen reader compatibility.
  • Global Multilingual Support: 36 languages with flag dropdown – ideal for international sites.
  • Fully Customizable Design: Tweak widget position, colors, fonts, borders, and shadows in the admin. Pro adds custom icons and no branding.
  • SEO & Performance Boost: Fast-loading code improves user metrics, ranking higher for “best free WordPress accessibility plugin.”
  • WCAG 2.2 Compliance at Its Core: Addresses 1.4.3 (contrast), 1.4.4 (resizing), 1.4.12 (spacing), 2.3.3 (animations), and beyond.
  • Admin Tools: AI alt text, contrast analyzer, WCAG reports (Pro for full scans).
  • New! Free Advanced Auto-Fixes: Toggle to auto-resolve issues:
    • Smart ARIA Stripper: Removes invalid ARIA from icons (e.g., UAGB SVGs) for WCAG 4.1.2 compliance.
    • Auto-Alt & Role Cleaner: Fixes empty alts and roles (Pro: AI-generated).
    • Heading Hierarchy Enforcer: Corrects skipped levels for logical navigation (WCAG 1.3.1).
    • Global Contrast Enforcer: Site-wide overrides for low-contrast text.
    • Touch Target Expander: 48px min for mobile taps (WCAG 2.5.5).
    • Widget Label Injector: Hidden labels for forms (WCAG 3.3.2).

Real Benefits for Your Site

  • Inclusivity Wins: Serve 1B+ people with disabilities, plus seniors and global users – earn rave reviews.
  • Legal Peace of Mind: Meet ADA/WCAG to dodge costly lawsuits (e.g., Domino’s case).
  • SEO Supercharge: Accessible sites get better crawlability and engagement signals.
  • Zero Hassle: No-code setup; compatible with all major themes/builders.
  • Trusted by Thousands: From Pluginjoy – join the movement for a better web.

sections.installation:
1. Upload /wp-content/plugins/a11y-enhancer/ or search in Plugins screen.
  2. Activate via ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Customize at Settings > A11y Enhancer.
